newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 7.247 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 7.247 percent at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 77-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.247 percent versus 7.265 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 168-day bills was 7.203 percent versus 7.234 percent for the $75 million of similar treasury bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 329-day bills was 7.300 percent versus 7.396 percent for the $50 million of similar treasury bills tendered last week.
